finalists.label: Lipoma
finalists.why: It has the most specific for evidence, including a firm, mobile, non-tender mass and a discrete, well-demarcated, hypoechoic solid mass.

finalists.label: Benign salivary gland tumor
finalists.why: It has multiple for entries, including left facial asymmetry and a well-bordered, slightly enhancing soft-tissue tumor.

finalists.label: Hemangioma
finalists.why: It has some for evidence, but less specific than the other two finalists.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because the intraoral incisional biopsy demonstrated wide fibroblast proliferation, extremely similar to a fibroma, which is more consistent with Lipoma.
